SELECT d.decoration_id, d.skill_id, s.skill_name, d.skill_level, s.max_level AS skill_max_level, d.required_slot_size
FROM decoration d
INNER JOIN skill s ON d.skill_id = s.skill_id
ORDER BY d.required_slot_size, s.skill_name, d.decoration_id

SELECT d.decoration_id, d.skill_id, s.skill_name, d.skill_level, s.max_level AS skill_max_level, d.required_slot_size
FROM decoration d
INNER JOIN skill s ON d.skill_id = s.skill_id
WHERE d.required_slot_size = #{requiredSlotSize}
ORDER BY s.skill_name, d.decoration_id

SELECT d.decoration_id, d.skill_id, s.skill_name, d.skill_level, s.max_level AS skill_max_level, d.required_slot_size
FROM decoration d
INNER JOIN skill s ON d.skill_id = s.skill_id
WHERE d.required_slot_size <= #{slotSize}
ORDER BY d.required_slot_size, s.skill_name, d.decoration_id

SELECT d.decoration_id, d.skill_id, s.skill_name, d.skill_level, s.max_level AS skill_max_level, d.required_slot_size
FROM decoration d
INNER JOIN skill s ON d.skill_id = s.skill_id
WHERE d.decoration_id = #{decorationId}
